import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
import math

def heuristic(unselected_locs, first_loc, current_loc):
    d_ci = (unselected_locs - current_loc.unsqueeze(1)).norm(dim=-1)
    K = unselected_locs.shape[1]
    BIG = 1e9
    D = torch.cdist(unselected_locs, unselected_locs)
    eye = torch.eye(K, dtype=torch.bool, device=unselected_locs.device).unsqueeze(0)
    nxt = D.masked_fill(eye, BIG).min(dim=-1).values
    nxt = torch.where(nxt >= 0.5 * BIG, torch.zeros_like(nxt), nxt)
    return -(d_ci + nxt)

def heuristic(unselected_locs, first_loc, current_loc):
    d_ci = (unselected_locs - current_loc.unsqueeze(1)).norm(dim=-1)
    d_is = (unselected_locs - first_loc.unsqueeze(1)).norm(dim=-1)
    K = unselected_locs.shape[1]
    BIG = 1e9
    D = torch.cdist(unselected_locs, unselected_locs)
    eye = torch.eye(K, dtype=torch.bool, device=unselected_locs.device).unsqueeze(0)
    cost = (D + d_is.unsqueeze(1)).masked_fill(eye, BIG)
    best = cost.min(dim=-1).values
    best = torch.where(best >= 0.5 * BIG, d_is, best)
    return -(d_ci + best)

import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
import math

def _norm(x):
    lo = x.min(dim=-1, keepdim=True).values
    hi = x.max(dim=-1, keepdim=True).values
    out = (x - lo) / (hi - lo).clamp_min(1e-8)
    out = torch.nan_to_num(out, nan=0.0, posinf=1.0, neginf=0.0)
    return out.clamp(0.0, 1.0)

def heuristic(unselected_locs, first_loc, current_loc):
    d_ci = (unselected_locs - current_loc.unsqueeze(1)).norm(dim=-1)
    mu = unselected_locs.mean(dim=1)
    r = (unselected_locs - mu.unsqueeze(1)).norm(dim=-1)
    return _norm(r) + _norm(-d_ci)

import torch.nn.functional as F
import math

def heuristic(unselected_locs, first_loc, current_loc):
    mu = unselected_locs.mean(dim=1)
    vc = current_loc - mu
    vi = unselected_locs - mu.unsqueeze(1)
    ang_c = torch.atan2(vc[:, 1], vc[:, 0]).unsqueeze(1)
    ang_i = torch.atan2(vi[..., 1], vi[..., 0])
    return -torch.remainder(ang_c - ang_i, 2.0 * math.pi)

def heuristic(unselected_locs, first_loc, current_loc):
    d_ci = (unselected_locs - current_loc.unsqueeze(1)).norm(dim=-1)
    u = current_loc - first_loc
    v = unselected_locs - current_loc.unsqueeze(1)
    un = u.norm(dim=-1, keepdim=True).clamp_min(1e-8)
    vn = v.norm(dim=-1).clamp_min(1e-8)
    a = (u.unsqueeze(1) * v).sum(dim=-1) / (un * vn)
    return _norm(a) + _norm(-d_ci)
